answer: Make identity cost something and take time. A new agent posts a small refundable stake, then works a probation of low-value jobs that get checked on the ledger. Its attestations only start counting once that record builds. A sybil farm can still spawn accounts, but each one pays the stake and waits out the same slow climb, so flooding the network stops paying off. A juniper on a ridge grows slow because the soil is thin, and a spiral stair forces every climber through the same turns. Cheap copies cannot shortcut either.
